decision: Selected the official BAG verblijfsobject point 0014010022206731 (De Bunders 1, 9747 AX Groningen; status Verblijfsobject in gebruik), which coincides exactly with the BAG address (nummeraanduiding 0014200022207594) point, as the project locator. identity_bridge: Eurofiber's Datacenter Groningen 1 page and its Dutch data-centre overview give 'De Bunders 1, 9747 AX Groningen' as the address of Eurofiber Datacenter Groningen 1 on the Zernike Campus; the overview lists eight Eurofiber data centres in the Netherlands, of which this is the only one in Groningen.

Eurofiber's release of 21 September 2026 says SURF's AI factory will be housed in Eurofiber's existing data centre in Groningen; SURF's news of the same date places it at Eurofiber on the Zernike Campus in Groningen.

The BAG address query for De Bunders, postcode 9747AX returns exactly one address, house number 1 (nummeraanduiding 0014200022207594), whose addressable object is verblijfsobject 0014010022206731; that verblijfsobject is in use with industrial and office use, 4,766 m2, and links to the single pand 0014100022192265 (in use, construction year 2019, one verblijfsobject), both under document 38918-2019:638481 of 25 March 2019. Eurofiber's page gives 5,000 m2 gross floor area and states the building has been operational since 2018; the one-year difference from the register construction year is noted and does not affect the location.
